plain: A court's finding that a person is guilty of a crime.

webster.text: The act of proving, finding or determining to be guilty of an offense charged against a person before a legal tribunal; as by confession, by the verdict of a jury, or by the sentence of other tribunal, as in the summary convictions before commissioners of the revenue.

example.quote: And several grants and promises made of fines and forfeitures before any conviction or judgment against the persons upon whom the same were to be levied;
